The page's news items are dated 2026.11.17 and announce the launch of the dedicated site and of the partner-event application form. The week therefore spans 2027-02-22 (Mon) to 2027-03-05 (Fri), twelve calendar days, with linked events nationwide; the FIN/SUM 2027 page (finsum.jp) names itself the core event of the same week and gives 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-05 at Marunouchi.
evidence.inference: A twelve-day national fintech week with a Marunouchi core event concentrates finance-industry attention in central Tokyo in late February and early March 2027, which is relevant to a DeAI Day only where the two audiences overlap.
